question: Parasnath Hill is a sacred site where the High Court directed a ban on the sale and consumption of meat, alcohol intoxicants. In which state is Parasnath Hill situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parasnath Hill** is located in the **Giridih district** of the state of **Jharkhand**.
 
• It is one of the most important and sacred sites for the **Jain community**. It is also known as **Sammed Shikharji**.
 
• The **High Court** issued an order banning the **sale and consumption of meat, alcohol, and intoxicants** in and around the sacred site to preserve the religious sanctity of the area. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• Parasnath Hill is named after **Parshvanatha**, the 23rd Tirthankara in Jainism, and is believed to be the site where 20 of the 24 Jain Tirthankaras attained **moksha (liberation)**.
 
• The hill is a popular pilgrimage destination for Jains worldwide and is considered one of the **holiest places in Jainism**. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• The hill also has religious and ecological significance, being home to a rich diversity of **flora and fauna**, and is a part of the **Parasnath Wildlife Sanctuary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Religious Importance of Parasnath Hill:**

 
 
• Parasnath Hill is sacred to the **Jain community** and is referred to as **Sammed Shikharji**. It is one of the most significant pilgrimage sites for Jain devotees.
 
• The hill has **31 Jain temples** dedicated to different Tirthankaras. It is believed that **20 Tirthankaras** attained **salvation** on this hill.
 
• The hill is associated with **Parshvanatha**, the 23rd Tirthankara, making it a site of great spiritual importance.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Significance:**
 
 
• Parasnath Hill is the **highest peak** in Jharkhand, with an altitude of approximately **1,365 meters** above sea level.
 
• It is located within the **Parasnath Wildlife Sanctuary**, which is home to diverse flora and fauna, contributing to the ecological balance of the region.
 
 
 
• **Legal and Administrative Measures:**
 
 
• To maintain the sanctity of the site, the **High Court** directed a ban on the sale and consumption of **meat, alcohol, and intoxicants** in the area.
 
• This step was aimed at preserving the religious and cultural importance of the hill, ensuring it remains a place of peace and spirituality.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **About Jainism:**

 
 
• **Jainism** is one of the world's oldest religions, promoting **non-violence (Ahimsa)**, truth, and asceticism.
 
• The religion has **24 Tirthankaras**, with Lord Mahavira being the last and most prominent.
 
 
 
• **Other Important Jain Pilgrimage Sites:**
 
 
• **Palitana Temples** in Gujarat, **Shatrunjaya Hill** is another sacred site for Jain devotees.
 
• **Mount Abu** in Rajasthan, known for its **Dilwara Temples**, is also a prominent Jain pilgrimage destination.
